title: JBS Southern Hosts Successful Brand Week
summary: Another successful JBS Southern Brand Week was held in early October, bringing the spotlight to JBS Australia's Bordertown site and Great Southern Lamb.
body_markdown:
Another successful JBS Southern Brand Week was held in early October, bringing the spotlight to JBS Australia's Bordertown site and Great Southern Lamb. Held over three days, Brand Week gave employees from across the plant the opportunity to step into the chiller and learn more about the lamb brands they help produce every day. Brand Marketing Manager Harriet Brawne shared an overview of our lamb brands, with a focus on what makes each brand unique. Lamb Export Salesperson Lachlan Main then gave the team a look beyond the plant, sharing where different lamb cuts and products are heading around the world and the customers and markets they ultimately reach.


Employees from Harvest, Fabrication, Maintenance and Cold Store all had the opportunity to take part throughout the week. It was a great chance for teams across the site to learn more about the brands and see how the work happening at Bordertown connects with customers around the globe. To wrap up the week, everyone came together for a site-wide BBQ, where Head of Lamb Sales Warren Swanson spoke about the important role Bordertown plays in supplying customers across global markets.


With a special focus on Great Southern Lamb, Brand Week helped connect the production behind the brand with the finished products reaching customers around the world. More importantly, it was an opportunity to recognize the people behind those products and give employees across the site a greater understanding of where their work goes once it leaves Bordertown.
